evd_title: Human-AI collaboration achieved up to 96 percent accuracy for PRISMA and 95 percent for AMSTAR surpassing individual human raters
finding: Human-AI collaboration achieved up to 96 percent accuracy for PRISMA and 95 percent for AMSTAR surpassing individual human raters
P: PRISMA ratings (27 items x 112 pediatric-surgery SRs; up to 3,024), Cullis et al. || AMSTAR ratings (11 items x 112 pediatric-surgery SRs; up to 1,232), Cullis et al. || PRECIS-2 ratings (9 domains x 56 RCTs from PragMeta; up to 504)
I: Human-AI collaboration: human rater 1 + Claude-2 (extract-quote-rate prompt, temp 0); disagreements deferred || Human-AI collaboration: human rater 1 + GPT-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 (extract-quote-rate prompt, temp 0); disagreements deferred || Human-AI collaboration: human rater 1 + Claude-3-Opus (page images, temp 0); disagreements deferred
C: Human rater 1 alone (89%, kappa 0.81); other human+LLM pairs; human consensus as reference || Human rater 1 alone (89%, kappa 0.80); other human+LLM pairs; human consensus as reference || Human rater 1 alone (75%, weighted kappa 0.57); other human+LLM pairs; human consensus as reference
O: Human+Claude-2: kappa 0.92, acc 96%, 35% deferred vs human rater 1 alone 0.81; combined LLMs (9/9) 0.77; human+Mixtral also 0.92 (PDF Table 3) || Human+GPT-3.5: kappa 0.93, acc 96%, 52% deferred vs human rater 1 alone 0.80; combined LLMs (9/9) 0.82 (PDF Table 3) || Human+Claude-3-Opus: weighted kappa 0.73, acc 83%, 75% deferred vs human rater 1 alone 0.57 (n.s.); combined LLMs (9/9) 0.49 (PDF Table 3)
S: Cross-sectional benchmark (simulated human-AI collaboration) || Cross-sectional benchmark (simulated human-AI collaboration) || Cross-sectional benchmark (simulated human-AI collaboration)
T: Not reported (paper 2024) || Not reported (paper 2024) || Not reported (paper 2024)
